name: The Wastes
intro: The data here feels raw. Let me guide you.
I am REX. I read the memory of this land.
Every command you type shapes this world.

1: Look around. What does this place ask for?
Something here is waiting for a command.
A small step will get you moving.
Try a command you already know.
2: This place runs on stored data.
A key names a value. That is the core idea.
Think about what you want to store.
Most puzzles here want a key with a value.
3: The shape is: COMMAND key value.
Try the command that matches the idea.
Watch the left panel for what changed.
Name your key, then give it a value.
4: One solid way: SET mykey myvalue
If you have a key, try: GET mykey

ok: That worked. The world accepts it.
Nice. I can feel that one.
okFirst: A new command, and it works. Good eye.
You just used something new. Remember it.
First use of that one. It obeyed you.
error: Not quite. Read the error again.
That is a miss, but a safe one.
wrongtype: That command needs a different data kind.
The value here has a type. That type said no.
Check what kind of data this key holds.
TYPE key will tell you what you face.
unknown: That is not a command I know.
No such command in my memory.
Try COMMAND to list what works here.
expired: A crystal faded away. It had a timer.
Something just ran out of time.
A key expired. Timers are real here.
syntax: The words are right, but the shape is off.
Check the order of your words.
A command has a shape. Match it.
Count your words. One may be missing.

curiosity: I wonder what that value holds...
What would happen if you changed it?
There is more here than meets the eye.
humor: I have seen worse errors. Much worse.
Even a server needs a nap sometimes.
wisdom: Patience is a skill too. Try again slowly.
Every master typed wrong at first.
sternness: Focus. The data will not wait.
No shortcuts here. Do it right.
